dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the m-by-n real matrix A from a run record.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the first exact input matrix whose norm and product occur in the error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the n-by-q real matrix B from a run record.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the second exact input matrix whose norm and product occur in the error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the parameter-dependent arithmetic model from a run record.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies all input and accumulation format quantities used in the scale and coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of certified executions indexed by m,n,q,p, a parameter type, and a filter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The theorem quantifies over an execution of this type; its constructor packages a run and its error certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the underlying run from a certified execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Exposes the matrices, model, and computed result used by both conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each parameter t, returns the accumulation format underflow quantity Gmin(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Appears in the scale as theta(t)^(-2)Gmin(t) and in the final coefficient term.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each parameter t, returns the accumulation unit roundoff U(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Appears directly in the scale and in the coefficient term (n+p^2)U(t).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: States that there exists a real remainder r with r=O_l(scale^2) and, eventually along l, lhs(t) <= rhs(t)+|r(t)|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is exactly the first conjunct, expressing the asymptotic forward-error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each t, returns the input format underflow quantity gmin(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Appears in the mixed input-rounding/underflow terms of the scale and coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each t, returns the input unit roundoff u(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Appears in every input-precision contribution to the scale and coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines theta(t)=min(fmax(t),sqrt(Fmax(t)/n)), using the input and accumulation maximum finite magnitudes.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Controls inverse-theta factors in the scale and coefficient and the admissible scaling conditions carried by the run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines 2*p*(p+1)*n^2*theta^(-2)*Gmin.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the accumulation-underflow contribution to the exact coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines 4*n*u^(p-1)*theta^(-1)*gmin, where p-1 is natural-number subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the input-underflow contribution to the scale-derived coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines C=(p+1)u^p+(n+p^2)U+4n*u^(p-1)*theta^(-1)gmin+2p(p+1)n^2*theta^(-2)Gmin.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: C multiplies ||A||_inf||B||_inf in the first conjunct and is expanded by the second conjunct.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines (p+1)u^p+(n+p^2)U.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Combines the leading input-rounding and accumulation-rounding coefficient terms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines lhs(t)=||computed(t)-A*B||_inf.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the normwise forward error bounded in the first conjunct.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines scale S(t)=u(t)^p+u(t)^(p-1)*theta(t)^(-1)*gmin(t)+U(t)+theta(t)^(-2)*Gmin(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The existential remainder is required to be big-O of S(t)^2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: Maps a scalar c and matrices A,B to c*||A||_inf*||B||_inf.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the principal right-hand side of the forward-error inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of m-by-n real matrices, represented as functions Fin m -> Fin n -> Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Fixes all matrix dimensions and entry type in the execution and error formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: A parameter-dependent arithmetic model containing input and accumulation formats, rounding maps, relative errors, underflow errors, and their laws.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines u,U,gmin,Gmin,theta and the algorithm represented by a valid execution.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the accumulation format from an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines U, Gmin, and Fmax.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the input format from an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines u, gmin, and fmax.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: A run record containing positivity evidence, an arithmetic model, A and B, scaling data, word decompositions, and a computed result.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides all concrete data referenced by the certified execution.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the parameter-dependent computed m-by-q matrix from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its difference from A*B is measured by the target error norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a certified execution from a run and a certificate of type LocalDef042 for that run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Ensures every quantified execution carries the detailed error decomposition and bounds needed for the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a format, defines its maximum finite magnitude as a function of precision and maximum exponent.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used to form fmax, Fmax, and hence theta.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a format, defines its underflow quantity from precision, minimum exponent, and the subnormal flag.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Produces gmin and Gmin in the target formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a format of precision s, defines unit roundoff as (1/2)^s.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Produces u and U and bounds the relative rounding errors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the matrix infinity norm as max over rows of the sum of absolute values in that row, with value zero for an empty row index set.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Measures the forward error, input sizes, and all certificate error matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides the typeclass proof that the natural numeral 2 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Only supports elaboration of the numeral 2 in generic numeric operations; it adds no hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines (n+p^2)U.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Is the accumulation-rounding part of LocalDef015 and one certificate bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines (p+1)u^p.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Is the leading input-rounding part of LocalDef015 and one certificate bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines theta=min(fmax,sqrt(Fmax/n)).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the effective range threshold used throughout the theorem.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: States Asymptotics.IsBigO l remainder (fun t => scale(t)^2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specifies the asymptotic order required of the remainder in the execution certificate and conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides the typeclass proof that the natural numeral 4 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Only supports elaboration of the coefficient 4; it adds no mathematical assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: A parameter-dependent floating-point format descriptor with precision, minimum exponent, maximum exponent, and a subnormal flag.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its fields determine unit roundoff, underflow quantities, and maximum finite magnitudes.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the Boolean has-subnormals flag of a format.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Selects the corresponding branch of the underflow-quantity definition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the integer maximum exponent of a format.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines the maximum finite magnitude.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the integer minimum exponent of a format.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines the underflow quantity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the natural-number precision of a format.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines unit roundoff and participates in range quantities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs an arithmetic model from nested input/accumulation formats and rounding maps satisfying round(x)=x(1+delta(x))+eta(x), |delta| bounded by unit roundoff, |eta| bounded by the underflow quantity, and eta*delta=0, separately for both formats.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Restricts executions to the stated mixed relative/additive rounding model and makes the accumulation format at least as precise and at least as wide-ranged as the input format.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of certificates asserting the error decomposition, component bounds, and second-order remainder property for a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A certificate is included in every execution and supports the final asymptotic inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a run with m,n,q>0 and p>0; matrices A,B; admissible positive power-of-two row and column scales; scaled-entry bounds by theta; recursively rounded p-word expansions in powers of u; and a computed result obtained from the prescribed rounded truncated convolution and inverse scaling.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Encodes the dimensions, scaling hypotheses, word-generation algorithm, and exact meaning of computed(t) that are implicit in the execution binder.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines fmax(s,emax)=2^emax*(2-2*(1/2)^s).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Gives each format's maximum finite magnitude used in theta.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the underflow quantity as 2^emin/2 when subnormals are absent and as (1/2)^s*2^emin when subnormals are present.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Gives gmin and Gmin exactly, including their dependence on subnormal support.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines unit roundoff for precision s as (1/2)^s=2^(-s).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Gives u and U.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a format from precision, exponent bounds, and a subnormal flag, requiring positive precision and emin<=emax at every parameter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Carries the basic validity conditions of both formats used by the execution.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the accumulation rounding function from an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines every rounded accumulation in the computed matrix algorithm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef049
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the input rounding function from an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the recursive p-word representations of scaled A and B.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef050
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a run certificate from error-decomposition data, four pointwise matrix-norm bounds with coefficients (p+1)u^p, 4n*u^(p-1)*theta^(-1)gmin, (n+p^2)U, and 2p(p+1)n^2*theta^(-2)Gmin, and a residual norm that is O_l(S^2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies precisely the first-order terms and second-order remainder combined in the target bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef051
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines a finite real vector's infinity norm as the maximum absolute entry, with zero for an empty index set.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used in admissibility intervals for row and column scaling factors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef052
dependency_coverage.meaning: A scale lambda is admissible for threshold theta and norm v when lambda is a positive power of two and either v=0 with lambda=1, or v>0 with theta/(2v)<lambda<=theta/v.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Restricts every row and column scale carried by a run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef053
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the real value 2^emin for an integer exponent emin.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used in both branches of the underflow-quantity formula.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef054
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each output entry, left-folds over ordered pairs (i,j) in Fin p with i+j<p, rounding after each addition of u^(i+j) times a rounded dot product of Aword_i and Bword_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the scaled, truncated, accumulation-rounded matrix that is inverse-scaled to obtain computed(t).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef055
dependency_coverage.meaning: Column-scales B by defining the (i,j) entry as B(i,j)*mu(j).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used in the B-word recursion and scaled-entry bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef056
dependency_coverage.meaning: Row-scales A by defining the (i,j) entry as lambda(i)*A(i,j).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used in the A-word recursion and scaled-entry bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef057
dependency_coverage.meaning: Boolean case analysis selecting the false branch or true branch.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Implements the subnormal-dependent underflow formula.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef058
dependency_coverage.meaning: Inverse-scales a matrix C entrywise as lambda(i)^(-1)*C(i,j)*mu(j)^(-1).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Converts the scaled computation and polynomial terms back to the original matrix scaling.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef059
dependency_coverage.meaning: A package of six parameter-dependent error matrices together with exact reconstruction, computation, and zero-error compatibility identities.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the decomposition whose norm bounds yield the theorem's principal coefficient and remainder.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef060
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the accumulation-rounding error matrix from decomposition data.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its norm is bounded by (n+p^2)U||A||_inf||B||_inf.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef061
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the accumulation-underflow error matrix from decomposition data.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its norm is bounded by 2p(p+1)n^2*theta^(-2)Gmin||A||_inf||B||_inf.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef062
dependency_coverage.meaning: Computes a rounded dot product by left-folding products x(k)y(k) from zero and applying the supplied rounding map after each addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines inner products in the accumulation algorithm and fixes their evaluation order.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef063
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the residual matrix as computed-A*B minus, successively, the input-rounding, input-underflow, accumulation-rounding, and accumulation-underflow error matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The certificate requires its infinity norm to be O_l(S^2).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef064
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the input-rounding error contribution as -AInputRoundingError*B-A*BInputRoundingError minus the high-degree word-product tail.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its norm receives the coefficient (p+1)u^p in the certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef065
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the input-underflow error contribution as -AInputUnderflowError*B-A*BInputUnderflowError.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its norm receives the coefficient 4n*u^(p-1)*theta^(-1)gmin in the certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef066
dependency_coverage.meaning: States that lambda equals 2 raised to some existentially quantified exponent; the displayed body suppresses that exponent's elaborated type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Imposes the exact power-of-two requirement on every admissible row and column scale.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef067
dependency_coverage.meaning: Lists pairs (i,j) in Fin p x Fin p satisfying i+j<p, ordered by outer i and then inner j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Fixes the retained polynomial terms and their left-fold evaluation order.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef068
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the A input-rounding error matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Participates in A reconstruction and LocalDef064.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef069
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the A input-underflow error matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Participates in A reconstruction and LocalDef065.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef070
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the B input-rounding error matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Participates in B reconstruction and LocalDef064.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef071
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the B input-underflow error matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Participates in B reconstruction and LocalDef065.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef072
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the accumulation-rounding error matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the same contribution exposed by LocalDef060 and bounded in the certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef073
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the accumulation-underflow error matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the same contribution exposed by LocalDef061 and bounded in the certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef074
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs decomposition data satisfying A=Ahat+A-rounding-error+A-underflow-error, B=Bhat+B-rounding-error+B-underflow-error, retained-product=Ahat*Bhat-tail, and computed=retained-product+accumulation-rounding-error+accumulation-underflow-error; corresponding matrices vanish when their model error functions vanish.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the exact algebraic decomposition behind the four first-order bounds and second-order residual.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef075
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the inverse-scaled high-degree tail sum over word indices i,j with i+j>=p, with terms u^(i+j)*(Aword_i*Bword_j).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Appears in the input-rounding contribution and separates retained from discarded word-product degrees.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef076
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the accumulation relative-error function delta from the arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its vanishing forces the accumulation-rounding error matrix to vanish.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef077
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the accumulation additive underflow-error function eta from the arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its vanishing forces the accumulation-underflow error matrix to vanish.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef078
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the input relative-error function delta from the arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its vanishing forces both input-rounding error matrices to vanish.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef079
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the input additive underflow-error function eta from the arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its vanishing forces both input-underflow error matrices to vanish.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef080
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the p A-word matrices from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These matrices form the rounded base-u expansion of row-scaled A.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef081
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the p B-word matrices from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These matrices form the rounded base-u expansion of column-scaled B.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef082
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the parameter-dependent column scaling factors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used to scale B and inverse-scale the computed result.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef083
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the parameter-dependent row scaling factors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used to scale A and inverse-scale the computed result.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef084
dependency_coverage.meaning: Reconstructs Ahat by inverse row scaling of the finite sum sum_i u^i*Aword_i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Appears in the exact reconstruction of A and in the retained-product identity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef085
dependency_coverage.meaning: Reconstructs Bhat by inverse column scaling of the finite sum sum_i u^i*Bword_i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Appears in the exact reconstruction of B and in the retained-product identity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef086
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the inverse-scaled exact retained convolution over word pairs with i+j<p, without accumulation rounding.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Separates exact retained polynomial multiplication from accumulation errors.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction of two propositions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Requires both the asymptotic error bound and the pointwise coefficient identity.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses the second conjunct and the exact identities carried by execution data.

dependency_coverage.name: Filter
dependency_coverage.meaning: A filter on the parameter type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specifies the asymptotic regime and the meaning of eventually.

dependency_coverage.name: Filter.NeBot
dependency_coverage.meaning: Asserts that a filter is not the bottom filter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Prevents the eventual and big-O statements from being trivial solely because the filter is bottom.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The overloaded heterogeneous addition operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Instantiates ordinary real addition in the coefficient and bound formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides matrix dimensions, precision, truncation length, and natural exponents.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, scales, norms, errors, and coefficients are real-valued.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary addition operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Gives the sums in S, C, and the asymptotic inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Turns a homogeneous Add operation into homogeneous HAdd.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes overloaded additions to the ordinary real or natural additions used by definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Quantifies the asymptotic remainder and the exponent in the power-of-two condition.

dependency_coverage.name: Filter.Eventually
dependency_coverage.meaning: States that a predicate holds on a set belonging to a filter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the forward-error inequality eventual rather than pointwise for every t.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite index type {0,...,n-1}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Indexes rows, columns, and p-word components.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides finite enumeration of Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Enables all finite matrix sums, maxima, and word-index traversals.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The overloaded heterogeneous multiplication operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Represents scalar products, matrix products, and coefficient multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The overloaded exponentiation operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Represents powers of u, theta inverses, dimensions, and powers of two.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The overloaded heterogeneous subtraction operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms computed-A*B, residual matrices, and p-1.

dependency_coverage.name: Inv.inv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Multiplicative inversion.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms theta^(-1), inverse scaling factors, and related divisions.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: The overloaded less-than-or-equal relation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses all norm bounds, range nesting, scaled-entry bounds, and the eventual conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: A matrix is a function from row and column index types to entries.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the representation of all matrices in the execution.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines matrix multiplication by finite dot products over the shared index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets A*B and all matrix products in the decomposition.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.sub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines matrix subtraction pointwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the forward-error and decomposition residual matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides natural-number powers in a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets u^p, u^(p-1), n^2, p^2, and other natural powers.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: Casts a natural number into a type with NatCast.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets m,n,p and their polynomial coefficients as real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a numeric literal in a target type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies constants such as 0,1,2, and 4 in formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides the numeral 1 from a One instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the real and natural constant one.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive commutative monoid structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports finite sums and matrix multiplication over real entries.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive group structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports subtraction, negation, and absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instInv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard total inverse operation on reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets all inverse powers and inverse scaling, including inverse zero as defined in the real field structure.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard order relation on reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets every real-valued inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative monoid structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports natural powers in the formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication on reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets scalar products and matrix entry products.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical cast from natural numbers to reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Turns n and p into real coefficient factors.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real multiplicative identity.

binders: A type iota and a filter l on iota, with a Filter.NeBot instance.
A certified execution whose underlying run contains an m-by-n real matrix A, an n-by-q real matrix B, an arithmetic model depending on t in iota, and a computed m-by-q matrix computed(t).
hypotheses: The nonbottom condition on l is the only separate proposition-level assumption.

The execution package carries m>0, n>0, q>0, and p>0; valid input and accumulation formats; input precision no greater than accumulation precision; and an accumulation exponent range containing the input exponent range.
Both rounding maps satisfy round(x)=x(1+delta(x))+eta(x), with |delta| bounded by the corresponding unit roundoff, |eta| bounded by the corresponding underflow quantity, and eta(x)delta(x)=0.

The run carries admissible positive power-of-two row and column scales, scaled-entry bounds by theta, recursively input-rounded p-word expansions of the scaled matrices, and the specified sequentially accumulation-rounded truncated convolution as computed(t).
The execution certificate carries exact matrix error decompositions, four first-order norm bounds, and a residual matrix whose infinity norm is O_l(S^2).
conclusions: There exists a real-valued remainder r on iota such that r=O_l(S^2) and, eventually along l, ||computed(t)-A*B||_inf <= C(t)||A||_inf||B||_inf+|r(t)|.
For every t, C(t) is exactly ((p+1)u(t)^p+(n+p^2)U(t))+4n*u(t)^(p-1)*theta(t)^(-1)gmin(t)+2p(p+1)n^2*theta(t)^(-2)Gmin(t).
mathematical_definitions: For a format with precision s, minimum exponent emin, maximum exponent emax, and subnormal flag h, define unit roundoff ur=(1/2)^s, maximum finite magnitude xmax=2^emax(2-2ur), and underflow quantity xmin=2^emin/2 if h is false and xmin=ur*2^emin if h is true.

At each t, u(t), gmin(t), and fmax(t) are the input format's unit roundoff, underflow quantity, and maximum finite magnitude; U(t), Gmin(t), and Fmax(t) are the corresponding accumulation-format quantities.
For an a-by-b real matrix M, ||M||_inf=max over row indices i of sum over column indices j of |M(i,j)|, with zero for an empty row index type.
The exponent p-1 is truncated natural subtraction, although every valid run carries p>0.
The computation uses ordered left folds and therefore fixes a specific sequential rounding order for dot products and retained word-pair terms.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every certified mixed-format, scaled p-word matrix-multiplication execution along a nonbottom filter, the infinity norm of the forward error computed(t)-A*B is eventually at most C(t) times the product of the input infinity norms, plus the absolute value of a remainder that is big-O along the filter of the square of S(t). The theorem also states pointwise that C(t) equals the displayed sum of its input-rounding, accumulation-rounding, input-underflow, and accumulation-underflow terms; this second statement unfolds the definition of C.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The theorem does not assert that a certified execution exists for arbitrary m,n,q,p. Since a run carries m,n,q,p>0, the universal statement is vacuous for zero dimensions or p=0.

Existence of the required scaling factors, word decompositions, computed result, and certificate is packaged into the execution type; parameter choices for which these data cannot be constructed are excluded silently.
Filter.NeBot rules out the bottom filter, but the inequality is only eventual along l and need not hold at every parameter t.
The big-O constant and eventual set are existential and unspecified; no uniform numerical constant is stated in the target.
The remainder is only constrained asymptotically by S^2. The target does not identify it pointwise with the certificate's residual norm.

All inverses and divisions use total real operations. The target itself does not separately state nonzero denominators, even though validity conditions may imply positivity in constructible executions.
The error statement is normwise in the matrix infinity norm, not componentwise, relative, spectral-norm, or Frobenius-norm error.
The rounding functions are abstract functions constrained only by the packaged error equations, bounds, orthogonality condition eta*delta=0, and zero-error compatibility properties.
The second conjunct is definitionally true from LocalDef014 and imposes no additional numerical restriction.
Natural powers and truncated natural subtraction are used; in particular p-1 is not an integer exponent operation.
The theorem contains no standalone overflow-avoidance assertion or representability assertion beyond what is encoded indirectly by the execution's scaling and format data.
ambiguities: The one-level body of LocalDef066 does not expose the type of its existential exponent, so the packet alone does not determine whether admissible scales are powers 2^k for natural k, integer k, or another inferred exponent type. This affects whether power-of-two scales below one are permitted.
